```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(naniar)
library(tidyr)
library(brms)
```

## R Markdown


```{r}
dfHIV <- read.csv("./DataRaw/hiv_6624_final.csv") %>% 
  filter(years == 0 | years == 2)

# count subjects before dropping missing
nrow(dfHIV %>% group_by(newid) %>% summarise(n=n()))

dfHIV <- dfHIV %>% select(newid, AGG_MENT, AGG_PHYS, BMI, SMOKE, LEU3N, VLOAD, RACE, EDUCBAS, age, ADH, years, hard_drugs) 

dfHIV <- dfHIV %>% pivot_wider(names_from = years, values_from = c(AGG_MENT, AGG_PHYS, BMI, SMOKE, LEU3N, VLOAD, RACE, EDUCBAS, age, ADH, hard_drugs)) %>%
  filter(!(is.na(AGG_MENT_0) | is.na(AGG_MENT_2) | is.na(AGG_PHYS_0)| is.na(AGG_PHYS_2) | is.na(LEU3N_0) | is.na(LEU3N_2) | is.na(VLOAD_0) | is.na(VLOAD_2))) 

nrow(dfHIV)

nrow(dfHIV %>% filter((BMI_0 > 100) | (BMI_0 < 0)))

# adherences top 2 vs bottom 2 categories
# current smopker vs not current smoker

dfHIV <- dfHIV %>%
  mutate(BMI_0 = ifelse((BMI_0 > 100) | (BMI_0 < 0), NA, BMI_0),
         logVLOAD_0 = log(VLOAD_0),
         logVLOAD_2 = log(VLOAD_2),
         MENT_DIFF = AGG_MENT_2 - AGG_MENT_0,
         PHYS_DIFF = AGG_PHYS_2 - AGG_PHYS_0,
         logVLOAD_DIFF = logVLOAD_2 - logVLOAD_0,
         LEU3N_DIFF = LEU3N_2 - LEU3N_0,
         collegeDegree = ifelse(EDUCBAS_0 <= 4, 0, 1),
         white = ifelse(RACE_0 == 1, 1, 0),
         smoker = ifelse(SMOKE_0 == 3, 1, 0),
         adherenceHigh = ifelse(ADH_2 < 3, 0, 1)) %>% 
  select(-c(BMI_2, SMOKE_2, RACE_2, EDUCBAS_2, age_2, ADH_0, hard_drugs_2))
```

```{r}
# table of adherence
```

```{r}
# Base models with no adherence
modelMentalFrequentist <- lm(MENT_DIFF ~ hard_drugs_0 + AGG_MENT_0 + age_0 + BMI_0 + white + smoker + collegeDegree, data=dfHIV)
summary(modelMentalFrequentist)

modelPhysicalFrequentist <- lm(PHYS_DIFF ~ hard_drugs_0 + AGG_PHYS_0 + age_0 + BMI_0 + white + smoker + collegeDegree, data=dfHIV)
summary(modelPhysicalFrequentist)

modelTCellsFrequentist <- lm(LEU3N_DIFF ~ hard_drugs_0 + LEU3N_0 + age_0 + BMI_0 + white + smoker + collegeDegree, data=dfHIV)
summary(modelTCellsFrequentist)

modellogVLoadFrequentist <- lm(logVLOAD_DIFF ~ hard_drugs_0 + logVLOAD_0 + age_0 + BMI_0 + white + smoker + collegeDegree, data=dfHIV)
summary(modellogVLoadFrequentist)
```

```{r}
# Models with adherence
modelMentalFrequentistADH <- lm(MENT_DIFF ~ hard_drugs_0 + adherenceHigh + AGG_MENT_0 + age_0 + BMI_0 + white + smoker + collegeDegree, data=dfHIV)
summary(modelMentalFrequentistADH)

modelPhysicalFrequentistADH <- lm(PHYS_DIFF ~ hard_drugs_0 + adherenceHigh + AGG_PHYS_0 + age_0 + BMI_0 + white + smoker + collegeDegree, data=dfHIV)
summary(modelPhysicalFrequentistADH)

modelTCellsFrequentistADH <- lm(LEU3N_DIFF ~ hard_drugs_0 + adherenceHigh + LEU3N_0 + age_0 + BMI_0 + white + smoker + collegeDegree, data=dfHIV)
summary(modelTCellsFrequentistADH)

modellogVLoadFrequentistADH <- lm(logVLOAD_DIFF ~ hard_drugs_0 + adherenceHigh + logVLOAD_0 + age_0 + BMI_0 + white + smoker + collegeDegree, data=dfHIV)
summary(modellogVLoadFrequentistADH)
```

```{r}
# Base models with no adherence
# set priors
priors <- c(
  set_prior("normal(0, 100)"),
  set_prior("normal(0, 100)"),
  set_prior("halfnormal(0, 100)"))
modelMentalBayesian <- brm(MENT_DIFF ~ hard_drugs_0 + AGG_MENT_0 + age_0 + BMI_0 + white + smoker + collegeDegree, prior=priors, data=dfHIV)
summary(modelMentalBayesian)

modelPhysicalBayesian <- brm(PHYS_DIFF ~ hard_drugs_0 + AGG_PHYS_0 + age_0 + BMI_0 + white + smoker + collegeDegree, data=dfHIV)
summary(modelPhysicalBayesian)

modelTCellsBayesian <- brm(LEU3N_DIFF ~ hard_drugs_0 + LEU3N_0 + age_0 + BMI_0 + white + smoker + collegeDegree, data=dfHIV)
summary(modelTCellsBayesian)

modellogVLoadBayesian <- brm(logVLOAD_DIFF ~ hard_drugs_0 + logVLOAD_0 + age_0 + BMI_0 + white + smoker + collegeDegree, data=dfHIV)
summary(modellogVLoadBayesian)
```
